description: This file defines the ADODB_Pager class, which provides functionality for paginating database recordsets, including rendering navigation links such as first, previous, next, last, and page links. It is used within a PHP-based project to display database query results in a paginated format.

classes.name: ADODB_Pager
classes.description: A PHP class that manages recordset pagination, including generating navigation links, rendering grids, and handling user interaction for paged datasets.

methods.name: ADODB_Pager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the pager with database connection, SQL query, and optional settings.

methods.name: Render_First
methods.description: Generates a link to the first page of the recordset.

methods.name: render_next
methods.description: Generates a link to the next page of the recordset.

methods.name: render_last
methods.description: Generates a link to the last page of the recordset.

methods.name: render_pagelinks
methods.description: Displays page number links within the pagination control.

methods.name: render_prev
methods.description: Generates a link to the previous page of the recordset.

methods.name: RenderGrid
methods.description: Renders the current recordset as an HTML grid, overriding for custom formatting.

methods.name: RenderNav
methods.description: Builds the complete navigation bar including first, previous, page numbers, next, and last links.

methods.name: RenderPageCount
methods.description: Displays the current page number and total pages.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main method to execute the pagination process, fetch data, and render the complete interface.

methods.name: RenderLayout
methods.description: Allows overriding the layout of the entire pagination block.
